Location taken: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History. Names: Glyptemys insculpta (Le Conte, 1830), (North American) Wood Turtle, Baot koad, Bosbeekschildpad, Clemmyde Sculptée, Északi vízite
This wood turtle was spotted at Seney National Wildlife Refuge in Michigan. Wood turtles are the rarest of the three turtles species found on the Refuge. Photo by USFWS.
